reply.answer: Good news: every program that was on CPU 3 is still running. Their backups took over on CPU 1 and CPU 0, so no services are down. The risk is that these programs now have no backup until CPU 3 is repaired, and CPU 1 is overloaded. A second failure could stop payments. This needs hardware support and a senior to rebalance the load.
evidence: No backups available until CPU 3 is reloaded
reply.likely_cause: CPU 3 hardware fault; system running without spare capacity
reply.why: Only HPE support can replace or reload CPU 3, and moving load off CPU 1 changes the live system, so a senior must approve. Runbook RB-009 says: do not reload the CPU yourself.
